belief: Say what it is. Greek frozen yogurt. High protein. Low sugar.
world: Every post is an ad for the shop. The cup or the topping bar is large enough that a stranger knows this is frozen yogurt. The words Greek frozen yogurt, high protein, and low sugar are on the post, spelled exactly. The place is Aventura and Sunny Isles. Deep blue, warm white, cream, olive. People may stand beside the product. They are not the ad.
imagePosts: Carousels of 3 or 4 slides. The product, the offer in words, then the real logo copied from the file. One caption that repeats Greek frozen yogurt, high protein, and low sugar.
videoPosts: One 15 second vertical scene with the cup large in the frame. Words on screen only if they are spelled exactly: Greek frozen yogurt, high protein, low sugar.
rules: Open these files before writing a post.
Brand references are logo, cart, uniforms, and toppings.
The opening is Aventura and Sunny Isles.
Use the week's frozen yogurt idea only as a spark for the flavor or the moment. The product stays in the frame.
The caption says Greek frozen yogurt, high protein, and low sugar, and that the shop is opening in Aventura and Sunny Isles.
Match the blue, white, olive, and thick white yogurt.
The cart is optional. Use it only for a shop episode.
Image posts are carousels. Copy the real logo from the logo file. Do not let the model invent the letters.
Words on a slide are allowed when they name the product. Spell them exactly.
Do not name other frozen yogurt brands.

images.shows: Circular blue logo. Olive branch, Títi script, Greek frozen yogurt, Greek key.
White and deep-blue frozen yogurt cart with olive branches, a topping case, and palms. Sign reads Sunny Isles.
Opening uniforms: deep-blue apron, cream hoodie, cream t-shirt, two-tone cap, blue sweatpants, all with the olive logo.
Topping bar. Ceramic bowls, pink crumble, chocolate, nuts, wooden spoons, blue and white.
